_comment: v3 vision encoder with PLACEMENT-VARIANT expansion. Each DSP segment is modeled as one of three variants chosen from honest profile data: DSP-mono (1 dispatch on DSP), CPU-mono (1 dispatch on CPU), or HTA-bundle (5 dispatches: trampoline_p0 CPU → conv1 HTA → trampoline_p1 CPU → conv2 HTA → trampoline_p2 CPU). The expanded dispatch graph has 97 dispatches (was 49). Profile CSVs use prohibitive costs on non-preferred backends to steer the scheduler. cpu_seg_XX segments stay CPU-only.
